label: Claude Sonnet 5.5
output:
**Subject: Lotus Glow Nails is OK, we open again Monday!**

Hello my friends and neighbors,

Many of you are calling and texting me, so I write this one letter for everybody. Please pass it around.

Early Sunday morning, Nov 8, around 2am, a car drove through the front window of Lotus Glow Nails. Thank God nobody was inside. The driver is OK too. The police came, and her insurance will pay.

The front glass is gone and the pedicure chair is smashed. The car stopped exactly at the pedicure chair, like she wanted a spa day! My daughter says she got the first drive-thru pedicure in Houston. The floor looks like a rainbow threw up, and my husband says finally our shop is modern art. 😄

I cried a little Sunday morning, I am not going to lie. But now I am OK. God protected us, because if somebody was inside it would be a very different story.

**Here is what you need to know:**

- The city inspector must check the wall before we can open. Our contractor says we reopen **Monday, Nov 16**.
- This week, me, Trang, and Kim are working at my cousin Hoa's salon, **Pearland Nail Bar**. Please call or text my cell first at **832-555-0147** and we will get you in.
- Your gift cards are still good. Nobody loses any money.

Thank you so much for all the texts, the prayers, and the food. Mrs. Dung brought me pho this morning and I almost cried again, but happy this time. I have the best customers and the best neighbors, and after 11 years on Bellaire Blvd you are all like family to me.

Please don't worry about me. Just laugh a little with us, and come see us this week at Pearland or next week at home.

See you soon!

With love and thanks,
Your nail lady
Lotus Glow Nails
